title: TikTok Scraper Input
description: Choose your starting point: hashtags, profiles, search results, or specific TikToks. To try the scraper, add a hashtag, set Number of videos, and hit Start.

hashtags.title: Videos with this hashtag
hashtags.description: TikTok hashtags to scrape. Enter without the # symbol. TikTok is restricting anonymous hashtag browsing, so hashtag runs may return 0 videos without a logged session. Profile and direct video URL inputs are the most reliable.

resultsPerPage.title: Number of videos per hashtag, profile or search
resultsPerPage.description: Cap on how many videos are returned per source. Larger numbers take longer and cost more.

profiles.title: TikTok profiles data
profiles.description: TikTok usernames or profile URLs. Returns profile stats plus recent videos. Enter with or without @.

profileScrapeSections.title: Profile sections
profileScrapeSections.description: Which profile tab to scrape when a profile is supplied.

searchQueries.title: Search
searchQueries.description: Keyword searches to run on TikTok. TikTok redirects anonymous searches to the For You feed, so search runs may return 0 videos without a logged session. Profile and direct video URL inputs are the most reliable.

videoUrls.title: Video URLs
videoUrls.description: Direct TikTok video URLs to scrape without running a search. Example: https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/1234567890.

downloadVideos.title: Download TikTok videos
downloadVideos.description: Save each video as an MP4 file to the key value store and include a public link in the output row. Adds storage cost.

downloadSubtitles.title: Download TikTok subtitles or transcription ($)
downloadSubtitles.description: Extract auto generated captions or transcribe audio when captions are missing. Paid feature.

subtitleLanguages.title: Subtitle languages
subtitleLanguages.description: Preferred subtitle language codes. First match wins. Example: en, es, fr.

scrapeComments.title: TikTok comments ($)
scrapeComments.description: Open each video and collect the top comments. Paid feature.

maxCommentsPerVideo.title: Max comments per video
maxCommentsPerVideo.description: Cap on comments returned per video. 0 disables.

countryCode.title: Scrape as in a country filter ($)
countryCode.description: Return results as they appear to a viewer in this country. Two letter ISO code. Leave blank for default. Paid feature when set.
countryCode.sectionCaption: Scrape as in a country filter ($)

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip video IDs already pushed in previous runs. Turn off to track changes to the same video over time.

maxVideosTotal.title: Max videos per run
maxVideosTotal.description: Hard cap across all sources. Controls total cost.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy. Residential strongly recommended. TikTok blocks datacenter IPs.
